pyramiding_rule: Strictly prohibit adding to positions within 1 hour of a prior stop-out; only pyramid when existing position is at least +$10 in profit and trailing stop is at break-even.
new_mandatory_entry_filter: Require minimum 3-candle momentum confirmation and volume delta alignment away from known institutional liquidity pools before order execution.
profit_harvest_threshold: Scale out 50% of position at +$10.00 and let the remaining run with an aggressive trailing stop to achieve asymmetric +$15 to +$30 outcomes.
